name: Geunchogo of Baekje
contribution: The 13th king of Baekje, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea.

checks.lead: King Geunchogo, Chogo II  (324–375, r. 346–375) was the 13th king of Baekje, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea. He is claimed as the King reigned over the apex of Baekje's powers.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
